lease_id.description: Optional lease identifier for revocable grants. If present, the grant is expected to be enforceable via a mediated handle (proxy or fresh-open) and revocation can be recorded as portal.revoke evidence.

request_digest.description: Digest of canonical portal.request bytes (e.g., sha256:...)

decision.description: Portal grants are emitted only for allow decisions in v0; deny decisions may be logged separately.

type.description: Capability type; v0 is intentionally small.

constraints.description: Optional additional constraints (rate limits, one-shot, size limits, etc.).

context.description: Binds grants to higher-level DeriveBSD objects when relevant.

policy_decision_digest.description: Digest of policy decision record that justified this grant.

expires_at.description: ISO8601 time. Optional for one-shot/raw grants; strongly recommended (and effectively required) for lease-based grants.
